newsitem.title: USA: Seibels Bruce looks to sell 11.4 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Seibels Bruce looks to sell 11.4 mln shrs.

text.p: The Seibels Bruce Group Inc said Thursday it will file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to register up to an aggregate of approximately 11.4 million shares of its common stock.

About 7.4 million shares will be registered for resale by Saad Alissa and certain of his affiliates. Alissa is a Saudi Arabian investor who purchased a stake in the company about three years ago, said the company. In addition, about four million shares will be registered for sale by the company.
The company currently intends to file the registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in March.
Seibels Bruce offers excess and surplus lines, personal lines, commercial lines, and flood insurance products as well as managing general agent services.
